[7:03PM] #Marina #TrafficUpdate 

Improved movement from UBA Roundabout towards NNPC Filling Station, with a smooth flow of traffic inward journey from Cathedral Church to Nitel Intersection.
Good traffic flow along State House frontage, inward to McWen, connecting to Force Road.
Efficient movement from Zone 2 Underneath the Bridge towards Flagstaff House, inward to McWen Bridge, and en route to Bonny Camp.
Favorable traffic conditions from Onikan Roundabout towards TBS, inward to Water Board, and connecting to Nitel Intersection, with the entire stretch of Broad Street experiencing good movement.
Smooth traffic flow from General Hospital towards Tinubu Square, connecting to Abibu Oki Street by Martins Junction, although approaching Davies Street, the inward journey from Apongbon is experiencing slow and steady movement due to commercial activities.
Faster movement on Igbosere Road and Catholic Mission Street, connecting to Ganiu Smith Street.

Traffic Officers are actively on ground to monitor the situation.

#FollowLASTMA
